author: safenessutte
quote: Terrible, who is this game even for? Rockstar has either completely lost sight of who their audience is and what they want, or they actively disdain them and want to humiliate those who have been their core audience for decades. These developers at Rockstar fail to realise that they would be nothing without this core audience.
